maria (product): hey team :wave: quick FYI — LargeCorp asked for a pin-exemption path for a legacy model they depend on. they want a 6mo pin+SLA guarantee for latency and a rollback window. thoughts?
ajohnson: do we have precedent for exceptions like this? sounds risky for long term catalog stability.
devon (eng-runtime): we usually allow short pins (<=30d) with manual canary and perf gates. 6 months is unusual. what are their traffic patterns?
maria (product): ~200 qps at peak, steady daytime traffic, sensitive to tail latency. they'd pay for reserved capacity but want pin & no auto-migrate.
samira (eng-ml): baseline question: is the model binary-stable vs our runtime kernels? if not, pinning still won't prevent perf regressions when infra changes.
jules (solutions): LargeCorp has compliance constraints — they signed earliest contract language. Ops is okay with reserved capacity if we get clear rollback triggers.
ajohnson: proposal: conditional pin exemption lane. criteria: customer pays reserved commit, submit an eval set, we run SLA canary every release. if canary fails thrice in a 4-week window -> auto-unpin after notice.
devon (eng-runtime): technical requirements: must ship a compatibility shim if we change kernel ABI. also need a perp-release test that runs their eval set. Can we automate?
samira (eng-ml): we can add their eval to nightly regression suite under opt-in. note: results are noisy; we need acceptance thresholds. recommend ROC-AUC delta < 1% and median latency delta < 15ms.
jules (solutions): ok — commercial terms and SLOs look doable. who owns the rollback notifier and customer comms?
ajohnson: product + account exec should own comms. eng owns the gates and automation. need runbook: quick commands for emergency unpin and migrate. sample:`
```
# emergency migrate
redwood catalog unpin --model largecorp-legacy-v1
redwood deploy --model fallback-quant-v2 --scope largecorp-account-123
```
ops-bot: deploy-bot: scheduled canary job created for LargeCorp eval set (job id: job_20230011). running nightly at 03:00 UTC.
maria (product): next steps: jules to confirm commercial terms, devon+samira to draft canary gating thresholds and runbook, ajohnson to add pin-exemption policy doc. sync in 48h? :calendar: 
ajohnson: ack. I'll start a PR for the exemption policy and link the sample runbook.
devon (eng-runtime): starting work on the automation hooks, will surface any infra blockers in PR.
samira (eng-ml): I'll curate the eval set and pick stable metrics.
jules (solutions): looping in AE and legal, will update by EOD tomorrow. :thumbsup:
